name: @w6w-apps/sender
description: Send campaigns, manage subscribers, groups, segments and custom events on Sender (sender.net).

w6w.longDescription:
Sender (sender.net) is an email (and SMS) marketing platform. This app covers the parts of its REST API v2 (`api.sender.net/v2`) confirmed against the vendor's own published documentation at api.sender.net: subscribers (create, read, update, delete, group membership, phone removal, event history), groups, segments (read-only — the API exposes no segment-creation endpoint), custom fields, custom events (for triggering automations from outside data), campaigns (create, send, schedule, copy, cancel, delete, pre-send error checks), and account webhooks (a paid-plan feature).

Transactional campaigns, workflow management and the statistics endpoints are documented by the vendor but not implemented in this first pass — see the README for what was deliberately left out and why.

Sender's docs host (api.sender.net) answers HTTP 200 with its own homepage for ANY unrecognized path rather than a 404, so every endpoint here was verified against the sitemap's actual documentation page and its worked request/response example, never against path liveness.
